text: Just as it is not every wine, so it is not every life, that turns sour from keeping. Serious gravity I approve of in old age, but, as in other things, it must be within due limits: bitterness I can in no case approve.
author: Marcus Tullius Cicero
speaker: Cato
reference: Treatises on Friendship and Old Age
location: Rome or his villa at Tusculum, Italy (presumed)
